svg.title: Selective reporting inflates visible effect estimates
svg.desc: Two histograms show 2000 simulated estimates and the 328 that pass a two-sided p less than .05 gate. Both axes share the same scales. The true effect is .20 standard deviations; the selected mean is .490. Bar heights are percentages within each displayed set.

g.text: Selection makes noisy effects look larger
Reporting gate: retain only two-sided p < .05
The selected mean is 2.5 times the true effect.
